newsitem.title: SUDAN: Tribal clashes kill 12 in northern Sudan - paper.
newsitem.headline: Tribal clashes kill 12 in northern Sudan - paper.

text.p: Twelve people were killed after rival tribesmen clashed in a northern Sudanese province, a Khartoum newspaper reported on Friday.
The independent Alwan newspaper said the 12 were killed in al-Daien province after Reizegat tribesmen attacked al-Mustorat village and burned down houses of the Zagawa tribe.
Police were sent to control the situation, the newspaper said. It did not say when the incident took place or what sparked it.
Most tribal clashes in al-Daien province, notorious for lawlessness similar to the American "Wild West", are over scarce grazing land and water.
